knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The handbook treats covers as one layer that depends on people. Supervision continues while the pool is open for use, and the service worker does not certify safety.
Horseplay limits, depth markings and clear diving rules are behaviour rules the visit can check and reinforce.
Clear water means the bottom is visible at the deepest point. A clean-looking surface or a verbal assurance does not meet that condition.

practicalCriteria: The visit note names the responsible adult and records that the supervision question was asked
Barrier, gate and cover observations are recorded without any compliance or safety certification
Each drowning-prevention point given to the owner is in writing, dated and linked to the owner's response
The pool is never worked on or left open while the floor cannot be made out
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Visit note from one supervised home pool visit
Dated written advice sheet given to the owner
Referral record for any barrier or insurance question raised
stopWorkCriteria: Stating a pool or barrier is safe, certified or compliant
Working while a child is in or near the water without a responsible adult present
Working while the floor cannot be made out at the deepest point
Removing or bypassing a gate, cover or barrier to carry out work
